actors.name: Gustavo
actors.private_context: Gustavo is a mid-tier performer selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He plans to cold-email them this week. His usual booking rate is about one call per sixty cold emails. He wants to secure discovery calls.

actors.name: Procurement leads (40 individuals)
actors.private_context: Each lead is a procurement professional at a mid-market manufacturer in the Pacific Northwest. They receive many cold emails daily and may or may not respond to unsolicited outreach. They have no prior relationship with Gustavo.

shared_context: Gustavo has email addresses for the forty procurement leads. He can send cold emails to them through standard email channels. The leads can reply to schedule a discovery call. The cutoff for resolution is 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00.

starting_events.description: Gustavo begins sending cold emails to the forty procurement leads.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty procurement leads actually sent a reply agreeing to a discovery call before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
